[[ICFAI Business School Hyderabad]] | occupation = [[Civil Servant]] }} '''Atanu Chakraborty''' (born 5 April 1960) is a retired 1985 batch [[Indian Administrative Service|IAS]] officer of the [[Gujarat]] cadre, who served as the [[Chairman]] of [[HDFC Bank]] until 18th March 2026. He was appointed by the [[Reserve Bank of India]] in April 2021.{{cite news |title=RBI approves appointment of Atanu Chakraborty as part-time chairman of HDFC Bank |url=https://www.thehindu.com/business/Industry/rbi-approves-appointment-of-atanu-chakraborty-as-part-time-chairman-of-hdfc-bank/article34390586.ece |work=[[The Hindu]] |date=April 23, 2021}}{{Cite web|url=https://indianexpress.com/article/india/independent-directors-of-psus-not-just-psus-even-india-inc-likes-ias-on-board-as-director-7383486/|title=Not just PSUs, even India Inc likes IAS on board as director|date=2 July 2021}} He previously served as the [[Economic Affairs Secretary]] in [[Ministry of Finance (India)|Ministry of Finance]] [[Government of India]] until his retirement in April 2020.{{Cite web |last=Mishra |first=Asit Ranjan |date=2019-07-25 |title=Who is Atanu Chakraborty, the new economic affairs secretary? |url=https://www.livemint.com/news/india/who-is-atanu-chakraborty-the-new-economic-affairs-secretary-1564030011960.html |access-date=2025-11-25 |website=mint |language=en}} His participation in the economic policy making for India included Budget formulation, its passage in Parliament as well as fiscal management. == Education == He holds a degree [[BTech]] in Electronics and Communication engineering from the [[National Institute of Technology, Kurukshetra]].{{Cite web |title=Atanu Chakraborty • The Lakshmi Mittal and Family South Asia Institute |url=https://mittalsouthasiainstitute.harvard.edu/people/atanu-chakraborty/ |access-date=2024-07-15 |website=The Lakshmi Mittal and Family South Asia Institute |language=en-US}} He completed his post-graduate diploma in business finance ([[ICFAI Business School Hyderabad|ICFAI, Hyderabad]]) and an [[Master of Business Administration|MBA]] from the [[University of Hull]], [[United Kingdom]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.financialexpress.com/economy/psu-disinvestment-time-for-big-and-small-strategic-sales-says-dipam-secretary-atanu-chakraborty/1635073/|title = PSU disinvestment: Time for big and small strategic sales, says DIPAM secretary Atanu Chakraborty| date=7 July 2019 }}{{Cite web|url=https://www.moneycontrol.com/news/economy/policy/as-the-new-economic-affairs-secretary-atanu-chakraborty-has-his-task-cut-out-4250511.html|title=As the new economic affairs secretary, Atanu Chakraborty has his task cut out|date=26 July 2019 }}[https://www.hdfcbank.com/personal/about-us/overview/board-of-director The Board Of Directors Of HDFC Bank] == Career == Atanu Chakraborty is a retired 1985-batch [[Indian Administrative Service]] officer belonging to the [[Gujarat]] cadre and has served in various positions for both the [[Government of India]] and the [[Government of Gujarat]].{{Cite web|title=Gujarat Gas|url=https://www.gujaratgas.com/resources/downloads/3rd-annual-report-2014-15.pdf|website=www.gujaratgas.com|access-date=2025-11-27|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230511191356/https://www.gujaratgas.com/resources/downloads/3rd-annual-report-2014-15.pdf|archive-date=2023-05-11}} He has held positions in the Ministries of Finance, Ports, Industries, Petroleum and Natural Gas, Labour, and Home. He also served on the Boards of state-owned enterprises.{{Cite web|url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/modi-effect-rivals-ril-ongc-team-up-to-share-infrastructure/article9918486.ece|title = Modi effect: Rivals RIL, ONGC team up for to east coast sharing infrastructure| date=22 October 2017 }} In the Government of Gujarat, Chakraborty served as the Additional Chief Secretary of Industries and as Principal Secretary of the Finance Department. He was the chief executive of GSPC Group of companies, Gujarat State Fertilizers & Chemicals Limited (GSFC), GSFS Limited, and the Vice Chairman & CEO of Gujarat Maritime Board. He was also the CEO of Gujarat Alkalis and Chemicals Ltd (GACL). He has held the office of chief executive officer of Gujarat Infrastructure Development Board. This organisation manages the preparation and bidding of infrastructure projects, including preparing risks, sharing templates within the state of Gujarat.{{Cite web|title=About GIDB|url=https://www.gidb.org/about-us-about-gidb|website=www.gidb.org|access-date=2025-11-27}} He also served as the chairperson of National Infrastructure and Investment Fund (NIIF). Chakraborty has held positions in the Ministry of Finance, Government of India. He held the posts of Secretary, DIPAM, and Secretary, Department of Economic Affairs. Chakraborty managed economic policy, tax policy, and budget management for the state of Gujarat as Secretary to the Government of Gujarat. {{cite news | url=https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2018-01-16/india-pitches-bigger-oil-resource-pie-in-bid-to-lure-investments | title=India Pitches Bigger Oil Resource Pie in Bid to Lure Investments | newspaper=Bloomberg.com | date=16 January 2018 }} Chakraborty was an Independent Chairman on the Board of Yubi, formerly known as CredAvenue. He also Chairs the Boards of HDFC Bank Ltd, BAE (India) System Ltd.{{cite news | url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/news/company/corporate-trends/yubi-appoints-atanu-chakraborty-as-chairman/articleshow/94912048.cms | title=Yubi appoints Atanu Chakraborty as chairman | newspaper=The Economic Times | date=17 October 2022 | last1=Sarkar | first1=Brinda }}{{cite web | url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/money-and-banking/atanu-chakraborty-appointed-as-yubi-chairman/article66021740.ece | title=Yubi appoints Atanu Chakraborty as Independent Chairman of its Board | date=17 October 2022 }} Atanu Chakraborty has served as India’s alternate Governor on the Board of [[World Bank]]. He was also a Member of the Central Board of Directors of the [[Reserve Bank of India]].{{Cite web|url=https://economictimes.indiatimes.com/industry/banking/finance/banking/rbi-approves-reappointment-of-atanu-chakraborty-as-part-time-chairman-of-hdfc-bank-for-3-years/articleshow/109821313.cms?from=mdr|title=RBI approves reappointment of Atanu Chakraborty as part-time chairman of HDFC Bank for 3 years|date=3 May 2024}} Atanu Chakraborty was appointed as the [[Economic Affairs Secretary|Union Economic Affairs Secretary]] by the [[Appointments Committee of the Cabinet]] (ACC) in July 2019. He was preceded by [[Subhash Chandra Garg]].{{Cite web|url=https://www.livemint.com/news/india/who-is-atanu-chakraborty-the-new-economic-affairs-secretary-1564030011960.html|title=Who is Atanu Chakraborty, the new economic affairs secretary?|date=25 July 2019}} He has served as Secretary of the Department of Investment and Public Asset Management (DIPAM) in the [[Ministry of Finance (India)]] where he handled divestment of state-owned enterprises. Chakraborty has served as the [[Director General]] of [[Directorate General of Hydrocarbons]] (DGH) in the [[Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas|Ministry of Petroleum]].{{Cite news|url=https://timesofindia.indiatimes.com/city/delhi/Govt-picks-GSPC-chief-Atanu-Chakraborty-as-DGH/articleshow/51128012.cms|title = Govt picks GSPC chief Atanu Chakraborty as DGH | Delhi News - Times of India|website = [[The Times of India]]| date=24 February 2016 }} He also served as Managing Director of Gujarat State Financial Services Ltd.{{cite web | url=https://www.livemint.com/market/stock-market-news/atanu-chakraborty-front-runner-for-sebi-chief-post-11582784827792.html | title=Atanu Chakraborty front runner for Sebi top post | date=27 February 2020 }} Chakraborty was the MD of [[Gujarat State Petroleum Corporation]], an Indian Oil & Gas company.{{cite web | url=https://www.thehindubusinessline.com/companies/gspc-group-appoints-atanu-chakraborty-as-md/article21032509.ece1 | title=GSPC Group appoints Atanu Chakraborty as MD | date=24 April 2015 }} == Publications == # BOT Law in the State of [[Gujarat]]; extract: Atanu Chakraborty (born 5 April 1960) is a retired 1985 batch IAS officer of the Gujarat cadre, who served as the Chairman of HDFC Bank until 18th March 2026. He was appointed by the Reserve Bank of India in April 2021. He previously served as the Economic Affairs Secretary in Ministry of Finance Government of India until his retirement in April 2020. His participation in the economic policy making for India included Budget formulation, its passage in Parliament as well as fiscal management.
